# Fitting Multiple OU Models to Tribal Simmap

```{r Import Water System Simmap}
all_species_tribe_simmap <- readRDS('Data/all_species_tribe_simmap.rds')
```

```{r Prepare All Species Data with their Water System or TRibal Occupancy}
#remember we are using the tree that has been pruned to those for which we know whether they are piscivorous or not

#import qualitative data
all_species_stored_data_piscivore <-
  read.csv('Data/all_species_stored_data_piscivore.csv')

#import quant data
all_species_matrix_data_piscivore <-  read.csv('Data/all_species_matrix_data_piscivore.csv')

#import piscivore pruned tree:
all_species_tree_piscivore_pruned <- read.tree('Data/all_species_tree_piscivore_pruned.txt')

#save edge lengths
all_species_tree_tribe_pruned_edges <- all_species_tree_piscivore_pruned$edge.length

#create trait variable for fitting discrete models:
all_species_tribe <- all_species_stored_data_piscivore$tribe
#collapse the tribes into basal riverine, haplochromini or lake_tanganyika:
#define the haplochromini tribes/subtribes
haplochromini <- c("Basal Haplochromini", "Haplochromini", "Basal Modern Haplochromini", "Tropheini", "Serranochromini")

#define tribes endemic to LT but that are not haplochromines
lake_tanganyika <- c("Benthochromini", "Perissodini", "Cyprichromini",  "Ectodini", "Limnochromini",  "Cyphotilapiini", "Trematocarini", "Eretmodini",  "Lamprologini", "Bathybatini", "Boulengerochromini")

#define tribes endemic to riverines but not haplochromines
basal_riverine <- c("Chromidotilapiini", "Hemichromini", "Pelmatochromini", "Coptodonini", "Gobiocichlini", "Steatocranini",  "Etiini", "Tilapiini",  "Pelmatolapiini", "Oreochromini", "Tylochromini", "Heterochromini")

#create mapping vector
tribe_category <- case_when(
  all_species_tribe %in% haplochromini ~ "haplochromini",
  all_species_tribe %in% lake_tanganyika ~ "lake_tanganyika",
  all_species_tribe %in% basal_riverine ~ "basal_riverine",
  TRUE ~ "unknown" # Fallback in case a tribe is not categorized
)

#define new species tribe array with species_names associated with it
all_species_tribe <- tribe_category
names(all_species_tribe) <- all_species_stored_data_piscivore$species_name

#convert matrix into dataframe
all_species_matrix_data_df <- as.data.frame(all_species_matrix_data_piscivore)

#isolate quantitative data
all_species_tribe_matrix <- 
  all_species_matrix_data_df %>%
  filter(names(all_species_tribe) %in% all_species_matrix_data_df$X)
```

```{r Define function to fit OUwie Models}

fit_multiple_regime_models <- function(
  tree_list,
  species_data,
  matrix_data,
  simmap_tree_index,
  fit_common_models = FALSE
) {
  ## Prepare OUwie dataframe
  ouwie_df <- data.frame(
    species_name = names(species_data),
    variable = as.numeric(species_data),
    tc = as.numeric(matrix_data[, 4])
  )

  fits <- list()
  aic_values <- c()

  ## Fit common models only once
  if (fit_common_models) {
    fits$BM1 <- OUwie(
      tree_list[[simmap_tree_index]],
      ouwie_df,
      model = "BM1",
      simmap.tree = TRUE
    )

    fits$OU1 <- OUwie(
      tree_list[[simmap_tree_index]],
      ouwie_df,
      model = "OU1",
      simmap.tree = TRUE,
      root.station = FALSE
    )

    aic_values <- c(
      BM1 = fits$BM1$AIC,
      OU1 = fits$OU1$AIC
    )
  } else {
    aic_values <- c(
      BM1 = NA,
      OU1 = NA
    )
  }

  ## Tree-specific regime models
  fits$BMS <- OUwie(
    tree_list[[simmap_tree_index]],
    ouwie_df,
    model = "BMS",
    simmap.tree = TRUE,
    root.station = FALSE
  )

  fits$OUM <- OUwie(
    tree_list[[simmap_tree_index]],
    ouwie_df,
    model = "OUM",
    simmap.tree = TRUE,
    root.station = FALSE
  )

  fits$OUMV <- OUwie(
    tree_list[[simmap_tree_index]],
    ouwie_df,
    model = "OUMV",
    simmap.tree = TRUE,
    root.station = FALSE
  )

  fits$OUMA <- OUwie(
    tree_list[[simmap_tree_index]],
    ouwie_df,
    model = "OUMA",
    simmap.tree = TRUE,
    root.station = FALSE
  )

  fits$OUMVA <- OUwie(
    tree_list[[simmap_tree_index]],
    ouwie_df,
    model = "OUMVA",
    simmap.tree = TRUE,
    root.station = FALSE
  ) 

  ## Append AICs
  aic_values <- c(
    aic_values,
    BMS   = fits$BMS$AIC,
    OUM   = fits$OUM$AIC,
    OUMV  = fits$OUMV$AIC,
    OUMA  = fits$OUMA$AIC,
    OUMVA = fits$OUMVA$AIC
  )

  list(
    tree_index = simmap_tree_index,
    aic_values = aic_values,
    fits = fits
  )
}
```

```{r Importing OUwie Results}

dir_path <- "Data/ouwie_per_tree/"

# list all tribe OUwie files
file_paths <- list.files(
  dir_path,
  pattern = "^tribe_ouwie_tree_[0-9]+\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# extract tree indices from filenames
tree_indices <- as.integer(
  sub(".*tribe_ouwie_tree_([0-9]+)\\.rds$", "\\1", file_paths)
)

# read files into a named list
ouwie_results_tribe <- setNames(
  lapply(file_paths, readRDS),
  tree_indices
)

#import models fit to the first tree (132), this includes the BM and OU1 model fits
common_models <-
  readRDS("Data/tribe_ouwie_common_models.rds")

#replace index 132 with the common models fit (which includes the BM and OU1 model fits)
stopifnot("132" %in% names(ouwie_results_tribe))
ouwie_results_tribe[["132"]] <- common_models

#replace whole index and switch to 1-100 for ease
names(ouwie_results_tribe) <- seq_along(ouwie_results_tribe)
```

```{r Extracting AICc Results}

models <- c('BM1', 'OU1', 'BMS', 'OUM', 'OUMV', 'OUMA', 'OUMVA')

ouwie_results_tribe_aicc <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_along(ouwie_results_tribe), function(i) {

    x <- ouwie_results_tribe[[i]]$fits

    # extract AICc for each model; use NA if a model wasn't run
    out <- sapply(models, function(m) {
      if (!is.null(x[[m]])) x[[m]]$AICc else NA_real_
    })

    data.frame(
      tree  = rep(i, length(models)),
      model = models,
      AICc  = unname(out),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  })
)


ouwie_results_tribe_aicc
```
```{r PLotting AICc Values}
#full (i.e. including saddlepoint fits)
ggplot(ouwie_results_tribe_aicc, aes(x=model, y=AICc))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter()+
  theme_classic()

#short cutting off bad fits
ggplot(ouwie_results_tribe_aicc, aes(x=model, y=AICc))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter()+
  ylim(-1250, -1000)+ 
  theme_classic() #looks like OUM is the best fit but some OUMVA fits are pretty good as well.... not according to the median AICc
```

```{r Export Filtered AICc for AICc Weights}

ouwie_results_tribe_aicc$regime <- 'tribe'

#filter out really bad fits (i.e. saddlepoints, probably)
ouwie_results_tribe_aicc <-
  ouwie_results_tribe_aicc %>%
  filter(AICc >= -2000, na.rm = TRUE)

write.csv(ouwie_results_tribe_aicc, "Data/ouwie_results_tribe_aicc.csv")
```









```{r Extracting AICc Results}

summary_aicc_tribe <- ouwie_results_tribe_aicc %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    removed = sum(AICc <= -2000, na.rm = TRUE),
    median   = median(AICc[AICc > -2000], na.rm = TRUE)
  )

summary_aicc_tribe
```

```{r Extracting OUM Parameters}

regimes <- c("basal_riverine", "haplochromini", "lake_tanganyika")

#identify trees with good OUM fits (all are good, so not really needed but good)
good_trees <- sapply(ouwie_results_tribe, function(x) {
  aicc <- x$fits$OUM$AICc
  !is.null(aicc) && aicc > -2000   # keep only trees with AICc > -2000
})

#extract parameters
param_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_along(ouwie_results_tribe), function(i) {

    # skip bad trees
    if (!good_trees[i]) return(NULL)

    x <- ouwie_results_tribe[[i]]$fits$OUM

    alpha_vals <- x$solution[1, ]

    data.frame(
      tree       = i,
      regime     = regimes,
      alpha      = alpha_vals,
      sigma2     = x$solution[2, ],
      theta      = x$theta[1:3],
      theta_se   = x$theta[,2],
      t_half     = log(2) / alpha_vals,
      row.names  = NULL
    )
  })
)

param_summary
```

```{r Summarise the Parameter Values}

median_range_parameters <- 
  param_summary %>%
  group_by(regime) %>%
  summarise(
    median_alpha = median(alpha),
    min_alpha = min(alpha),
    max_alpha = max(alpha),
    median_sigma2 = median(sigma2),
    min_sigma2 = min(sigma2),
    max_sigma2 = max(sigma2),
    median_theta = median(theta),
    min_theta = min(theta),
    max_theta = max(theta),
    median_theta_se = median(theta_se),
    min_theta_se = min(theta_se),
    max_theta_se = max(theta_se),
    median_half_life = median(t_half),
    min_half_life = min(t_half),
    max_half_life = max(t_half)
  )


median_range_parameters #note that the parameters do not show any variation because there is no variation in my simmaps, therefore parameters have been estimated for exactly the same simmap 100 times!

write.csv(median_range_parameters, 'median_range_parameters_OUM_tribe.csv')
```
